facts.text: Tento druh žil na Madagaskaru před 70 až 66 miliony let.
facts.quote: lived in Madagascar from 70 to 66 million years ago, at the end of the Cretaceous Period

facts.text: Tento druh měl malé zuby ve tvaru tužek, vhodné k trhání listů ze stromů.
facts.quote: small, pencil-like teeth were good for ripping the leaves off trees but not for chewing

facts.text: Na jeho kostech jsou stopy zubů dravého dinosaura majungasaura.
facts.quote: Majungasaurus tooth marks on Rapetosaurus bones indicate that it at least fed on these sauropods

facts.text: Mláďata byla schopná přežít téměř bez péče rodičů.
facts.quote: was also believed to have been capable of surviving with little to no parental care

facts.text: Mláďata vážila po vylíhnutí asi 3,4 kilogramu.
facts.quote: the juvenile Rapetosaurus was estimated to be 3.4 kilograms (7.8 pounds) in weight

facts.text: Dospělí jedinci dosahovali délky asi 15 metrů.
facts.quote: An adult would have been about twice as long (15 metres (49 ft) in length)
